chart.title: Average annual exposure to PM2.5 air pollution
chart.subtitle: The average level of exposure of the population to suspended particles less than 2.5 microns in diameter, which are capable of penetrating deep into the respiratory tract and damaging health. This is measured in micrograms per cubic meter.
chart.note: The WHO's Air Quality Guidelines suggest annual average PM2.5 exposure should be less than 5 µg/m³ in order to minimize the impacts of PM2.5  on human health.
chart.citation: Global Burden of Disease Study 2023, Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation (IHME), via World Bank (2026)
